name: Deep Agents Code
desc: Open-source terminal coding agent built on the Deep Agents SDK.
desc_zh: 基于 Deep Agents SDK 的开源终端编程智能体。
solves: Most terminal agents lock you into their harness; this one lets you swap the model and change how code execution is approved.
solves_zh: 多数终端智能体把你锁在它的框架里；这个可以换模型，也能改代码执行的审批方式。
best_for: You want a coding agent you can read, fork and re-approve on your own terms.
best_for_zh: 想要一个能读、能改、能按自己规矩设置审批的编程智能体。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — langchain.com product pages and the PyPI release record）。 Shipped as the `dcode` command. Released 2026-04-30, one week before the discovery window opens, and absent from the ledger, so it is recorded under brief rule (b). 首次公开日期来源：https://pypi.org/pypi/deepagents-code/json
